content.comment_body: Is it possible to open and edit language files of [product_name]? If so, what tools are required? I think having a Finnish language pack would make it easier to offer [product_name] to traditional electricians.

Hello, I don't think someone outside of [company_name] can translate these files. Have you contacted [company_name] in Finland to ask if a translation exists or if there's a plan for new language packs?

analysis.insight_summary: A user wants to modify or add new language files in [product_name] to support Finnish, hoping this will increase acceptance among certain electricians. Another user replies that modifying these files might not be possible for those outside [company_name], highlighting limitations in localization options.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes for a way to open, edit, or create new language packs—particularly Finnish—for [product_name], either through specific tools or an official process.
